description: Systematic Training and Validation of Parameterized Surrogate PLoM Model for Seismic Performance Assessment of Highway Bridges is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Jeonghyun Lee, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). This project features the development of efficient highway bridge seismic performance assessment using probabilistic learning on manifolds (PLoM). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: surrogate modeling, earthquake, regional, bridge networks, statistical modeling, hyperparameters. Published 2024-10-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
